name: Riverside Catacombs
description: A neglected burial network beneath Riverside, where old shrine foundations meet a natural water-cut cave. It is a starter dungeon with two ways back to town, not an isolated instance.

shrine_stairs.name: Shrine Understairs
shrine_stairs.description: Narrow stone steps descend from behind the shrine altar. The incense smell fades into cold earth, and the careful masonry gives way to much older stone below.

names_hall.name: Hall of Names
names_hall.description: Faded memorial tablets line this long chamber. Most names are worn smooth, but someone has recently set a fresh candle beside one of the empty niches.

burial_niches.name: Disturbed Niches
burial_niches.description: Small burial recesses fill these walls from knee height to the ceiling. Several have been opened by roots and scavengers, leaving old bones scattered in the dust.

sealed_chapel.name: Sealed Chapel
sealed_chapel.description: A low chapel survives beneath the town, its altar cracked but still marked with a sunburst. The wall behind it has split open into a rough natural tunnel.

root_cavern.name: Root Cavern
root_cavern.description: Tree roots knot through a natural cavern, drinking from a thin stream that has undercut the catacomb floor. There is enough room here for rats to nest and for water to find another way out.

cellar_breach.name: Cellar Breach
cellar_breach.description: A low natural tunnel rises into a patched brick breach behind stacked tavern barrels. The way is tight but passable; rainwater has been using it for years.
